mainEntity.name: What distinguishes an OJIX Operating System from generic SaaS tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generic SaaS tools force businesses to adapt real-world operations to rigid, one-size-fits-all software that produces disconnected silos. OJIX designs and engineers sovereign operating systems tailored around your organization’s actual roles, approval hierarchies, legal regulations, and operational reality—bringing cross-functional visibility, deterministic workflows, and executive clarity into one unified, sovereign environment.

mainEntity.name: Can OJIX integrate with or migrate legacy ERPs like SAP, Oracle, or Tally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. OJIX platforms feature enterprise bi-directional connectors, transactional event streams, and certified API adapters for legacy ERPs (SAP ECC/S4 HANA, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics), accounting suites (Tally Prime, Zoho Books), Core Banking Systems, and statutory government gateways (GSTN, MCA21, e-Way bill). We can operate as an intelligent orchestration layer on top of existing software or execute staged, zero-downtime database migrations with automated mathematical reconciliation.

mainEntity.name: How modular is the deployment? Can an enterprise start with one department?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every OJIX operating system is engineered around a composable micro-kernel architecture. Organizations frequently start with a single mission-critical capability—such as ProcureOS for automated 3-way invoice matching or Nyaya Sethu for contract automation—and progressively activate financial ledgering, inventory, or workforce management modules without code rewrites or platform migrations.

mainEntity.name: How does OJIX comply with India’s DPDP Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025?

acceptedAnswer.text: OJIX operates under strict compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and MeitY DPDP Rules, 2025. All personal data is processed under explicit consent with itemized purpose notices, unbundled cookie preferences, compatibility with registered Consent Managers, AES-256/TLS 1.3 encryption in sovereign Indian data centers, and a designated Grievance Redressal Officer reachable at info@ojix.in with a guaranteed 48-hour response SLA and 72-hour breach reporting protocols.

mainEntity.name: Where is enterprise data stored and processed in OJIX platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: 100% of enterprise client data resides in sovereign MeitY-empanelled Tier-IV data centers physically located within India. We enforce client-isolated VPC tenancies, encryption at rest via AES-256-GCM, and TLS 1.3 in transit. OJIX commercial contracts provide strict statutory guarantees of zero cross-border telemetry leakage and zero third-party data monetization.

mainEntity.name: What role-based access controls (RBAC) and audit capabilities are provided?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every user interaction, state change, approval step, data query, and API modification is cryptographically hashed and recorded to an immutable append-only audit trail. Granular RBAC and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) allow security administrators to restrict data visibility by department, geographic jurisdiction, role seniority, or client mandate.

mainEntity.name: How does OJIX ensure reliable AI workflow automation without hallucinations?

acceptedAnswer.text: OJIX builds deterministic, human-in-the-loop AI pipelines. LLMs and foundation models are strictly confined to scoped sensory tasks: OCR document extraction, natural language classification, drafting, and semantic clause comparison. All mathematical computations, financial ledgers, policy verifications, and ERP database updates are executed through auditable deterministic code with mandatory human approval gates.

@graph.headline: DPDP Act 2023 & DPDP Rules 2025: Enterprise Technical Architecture Guide for Data Fiduciaries
@graph.description: Comprehensive engineering and regulatory guide for enterprise CTOs, Data Protection Officers, and General Counsels on implementing Indian data protection compliance.

mainEntity.name: What are the core technical obligations for Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025?

acceptedAnswer.text: The DPDP Rules 2025 mandate: (1) itemized, non-bundled consent notices available in English and the 22 Eighth Schedule languages, (2) technical mechanisms for automated consent withdrawal, (3) data erasure and anonymization upon purpose fulfillment, (4) reasonable security safeguards including AES-256 encryption and tenant isolation, and (5) designated Grievance Officers with guaranteed 48-hour response SLAs.

mainEntity.name: What is the statutory timeline for reporting a personal data breach under the DPDP Act?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under Section 8(6) of the DPDP Act and the DPDP Rules 2025, Data Fiduciaries must notify the Data Protection Board of India (DPBI) and affected Data Principals within 72 hours of becoming aware of a confirmed personal data breach.

mainEntity.name: Does the DPDP Act require all personal data to be stored strictly in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: While cross-border transfer to non-blacklisted jurisdictions is permitted under Section 16, Indian sovereign cloud residency (such as MeitY-empanelled Tier-IV data centers in Bengaluru and Mumbai) is critical for Significant Data Fiduciaries (SDFs), government agencies, critical infrastructure, and defense/legal data.

mainEntity.name: How does automated 3-way matching work in ProcureOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: ProcureOS automatically cross-checks line items, quantities, agreed price rates, tax rates, and delivery milestones between the approved Purchase Order (PO), the warehouse Goods Receipt Note (GRN), and the vendor's GST e-invoice. If tolerances match within company policy, payment vouchers are generated automatically without manual data entry.

mainEntity.name: How does ProcureOS safeguard GST Input Tax Credit (ITC) for Indian enterprises?

acceptedAnswer.text: ProcureOS validates the vendor's IRN (Invoice Reference Number) and QR code via the National e-Invoice Portal and reconciles line items against your live GSTR-2B feed. Payments are released only when the vendor's GST filing reflects accurately, preventing ITC clawbacks and penalties under Section 16(2)(aa) of the CGST Act.

mainEntity.name: Does ProcureOS integrate with existing accounting software like TallyPrime, SAP, or Zoho Books?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ProcureOS features pre-engineered bidirectional connectors and webhook APIs. Approved bills, payment vouchers, and inventory adjustments synchronize directly with TallyPrime, SAP S/4HANA, Zoho Books, or Oracle NetSuite without disrupting your core general ledger.

mainEntity.name: Can ProcureOS enforce multi-level purchase approval hierarchies (Delegation of Authority)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can configure granular Delegation of Authority (DoA) matrices based on department, cost center, project code, or invoice value thresholds. Requisitions trigger instant approval alerts via email, portal, or SMS with full tamper-evident audit trails.

mainEntity.name: How does ProcureOS handle multi-location warehouse inventory and gate receipts?

acceptedAnswer.text: ProcureOS provides a mobile-ready Gate Inward module. Security and store managers record incoming vehicle numbers, physical gate passes, and perform batch/serial number inspections at the unloading bay, creating digital GRNs that immediately update inventory across all designated plant warehouses.
